We also have Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units up to $290 off today alongside a notable deal on one of my personal favorite chargers – the Anker Prime Power Bank with display that doubles as wall charger. All of that and more awaits below.

New M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini pre-orders now back in-stock at Amazon

Apple debuted and launched pre-orders for its upgraded M6 Mac mini and the M5 Pro model today and pre-orders are starting to go live at Amazon. Just make sure you also scope out that next-generation Apple Polishing Cloth for $9 before it sells out completely.

Apple debuted the first Mac with the new M6 chip today alongside the upgraded M5 Pro Mac mini and pre-orders are now going live on Amazon:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

After stock on the previous-gen M4 lineup all but disappeared over the few months at retail, the all-new M6 and M5 Pro models are now readily available at Amazon and there’s no telling whether or not Apple will be able to keep these in stock (it certainly had a hard time with the Neo).

Best Buy offering up to $500 off M6 Mac mini with M4 trades + 2x rewards for members

Apple’s official Bumper case drops to rock-bottom all-time low at under $13 (68% off)

Heads up iPhone Air users, Apple’s official Bumper cases have now hit rock-bottom all-time lows at Amazon from under $13 Prime shipped.

Amazon is now offering the official Apple iPhone Air Bumper starting at just $12.64 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

The Light Blue model at under $13 is now at the lowest price we have ever tracked on Amazon at a giant 68% off the $39 list price. The other colors are unfortunately up at a higher price and the black has completely sold out – the Light Blue model could be next at a price like this.

Yes it is just a simple Bumper that runs around the edges and covers of your device, but we are also talking about bargain bin pricing here on an official Apple case. It also allows your device’s design to shine through and makes for a notable bit of protection for folks that really only need a bit – it’s not going to safeguard the display for camera array, just the edges.

Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off today (Matching Prime Day deal)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my go-to recommendation for landing deals on iPhone, Apple does not sell its latest iPhone 17 Pro models there yet, and it looks like it won’t until after the 18 series lands next month. Amazon’s best quality Premium Renewed listings have now returned to Prime Day pricing at up to $220 off the new list prices.

Amazon’s top-quality Premium Renewed units have been the best option for landing deals on unlocked iPhone 17 Pro units thus far. Not only are you saving hundreds, but you’re also landing the 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life” – the not “premium” renewed and refurbished listings on Amazon only come with a 90-day warranty and you won’t get the same battery life grate either.

Right now you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – the 512GB is now $20 less than our previous mention as well:

Anker Prime Power Bank doubles as wall adapter: My favorite portable charger now down at $70

Anker and other brands make plenty of more powerful (or higher capacity) power banks, but this Anker Prime 9,600mAh model is my personal favorite. Now on sale down at $70, this one not features the onboard display, but it also has built-in outlet prongs so it effectively doubles as a wall charger too.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is offering the its 9,600mAh Prime Power Bank down at $69.99 shipped.

Carrying a regular list price at $90, today’s deal is on par with our previous mention, the official June Prime Day price, and the lowest we have tracked all year at Amazon.

Again, you will find higher capacity power banks out there, but this one has been, by far, the most useful option in my kit. It is far more compact than the larger capacity models, has more than enough juice to get my phone and MacBook through the day, and delivers on one feature not many other can: built-in outlet prongs.

This means, using the fold down outlet connectors around back, you do not need a separate wall charger to juice the internal battery back up – you can just stick it right into the wall. It will charge your device and its internal battery while doing so.

From there, you can expect to find a pair USB-C ports and Anker’s onboard 1.3-inch Smart Display:

It ships with a 2-year warranty, a USB-C Cable (100W, Briaded), and a travel pouch as well.

Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card for iOS or Android drops to $25 Amazon all-time low

Anker recently released a brand new SmartTrack Find My Card for you wallet – its first to support both Apple’s tracking platform and Google Find Hub – and it has now dropped to a new Amazon all-time low at $25 Prime shipped.

Anker’s official EufyHome shop on Amazon is now offering the new SmartTrack Card E40 for iOS or Android down at $24.99 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

It first landed on Amazon at $35 last month and after a light $5 price drop hit later that month, it is now seeing its first notable price drop to deliver a new Amazon all-time low.

You’re looking at nearly 30% off here and a price on par with some of the better deals we have tracked on comparable wallet tracker cards this year.

I’m personally a big fan of the Nomad Tracking Cards – they start at $35 and go up to $45 for the Pro model with 16 months of battery life before it needs a recharge – but no matter which you go with, I think everyone should have one of these things in their wallet or card carrier. I never leave the house without one.

The latest SmartTrack Card E40 from the Anker brand delivers on all of the most important features, including the wireless charging, while also working on either Apple’s Find My platform or Google Find Hub. It measures out at 1.7 mm in thickness and rings out at up to 80 dB to help track it down when you’re nearby – it, of course, loads right up into the Find My and Find Hub apps as well to see its location on the map.
